CHEF DE PARTIE - On-site - - Amsterdam , Noord-Holland , Netherlands - €2,505 - €3,032 per month - Kitchen - Leonardo Hotel Amsterdam Rembrandtpark  About the job The mise-en-place is completed and you are ready to start the show. Together with your colleagues, you are responsible for preparing and serving high-quality dishes. You work in a dynamic kitchen environment: one day you prepare premium meats, the next day fresh fish and other top-quality ingredients. Stress in the kitchen? Not for you. You maintain oversight, keep a clean and organized workspace, and ensure your partie runs smoothly during service. If you enjoy working with fresh ingredients and want to learn more about cooking techniques, this is the place for you. WHO ARE WE? By now, we have become a well-known name in Amsterdam-West. With eighteen floors, our hotel offers a spectacular view over the entire city. On the 17th floor, you'll find Floor17, where you can enjoy delicious cocktails and dishes at 85 meters high. Our rooftop terrace hosts the most exciting events, such as movie nights, ice hockey games, and relaxing yoga sessions. Want to hold a meeting with a breathtaking view? That's possible too! In short, Leonardo Hotel Amsterdam Rembrandtpark is a dynamic place to be! Job requirements WHAT MAKES YOU THE PERFECT CHEF DE PARTIE - Completed culinary training or at least 2 years of kitchen experience - Ability to work multiple parties - Passion for fresh ingredients and fusion-style cooking - Creative mindset and willingness to improve dishes - Fluent in Dutch and English - Flexible and available in evenings, weekends, and holidays To be considered for this role, applicants must be an EU citizen or hold a valid work permit for the Netherlands. WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU? - Salary range mentioned is monthly gross and for employees aged 20 and over. - Travel allowance for commuting distances of 10 kilometers or more. - Overtime can either be paid out ...

Soldering operatorWorking as as soldering operator at Benchmark means making solder joints, both mechanically as manually.As a solder operator at Benchmark you are responsible for manually placing components on prints. When necessary you check, and touch-up, prints. Your experience and skills help you on a daily basis to make additional or changed connections.Your tasks are, amongst others:· Visually checking the PCB with the help of digital instructions and technical drawings· Determining the process, together with manufacturing engineers, for (process) parameters for the series· Identifying deviations from the predetermined standards· Soldering, touch-op and outcoming goods inspectionYou will work with different kind of toolings, such as: soldering iron, hot plates and/or dryers. It is a very precise job where you will be working via a microscope or dynascope.What Benchmark has to offer to you:· A salary between € 2,751 - € 3,292 gross per month based on 40 hour workweek, depending on your knowledge and experience.· Broad development opportunities with the help of our Benchmark Academy.· Entrepreneurship is seen, valued and encouraged.· BeFit program: stay fit by exercising weekly with your colleagues or participating in sporting events.· A turnover-related quarterly bonus that can amount to 5%. This percentage may vary.· 40 vacation days during the year, when you are working on a full-time basis.What do we ask of you?· Experience as a soldering operator or experience with a micro-soldering.· Being able to work very precise and accurate.· Being able to read and follow technical drawings/work instructions.· Good knowledge of either the Dutch or English language.About Benchmark:Benchmark in Almelo is part of the multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., a listed company in the field of manufacturing electronics and providing services to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).At Benchmark you work for companies that make an impact with their innovations. We develop new products that improve safety or health or increase convenience. These products are supplied from product design to volume production and sometimes directly to the end user. This entire process, from design to production, is carried out entirely in Almelo.Globally, Benchmark Electronics Inc. currently has 23 locations. • Contribute to some HR transversal initiatives and team projects

• Fluent French and English, good knowledge of Dutch would be a plus
